results.content:
Title: Free Learning App for Kids Ages 2-8 | Khan Academy Kids
Inspire a lifetime of learning and discovery with our fun educational program for kids ages two to eight - 100% free! Watch how our fun learning games and story-based lessons help kids grow foundational reading and math skills. Young girl using the Khan Academy Kids app on a tablet to build early math skills. A learning app that grows with each child. Khan Academy Kids supports the whole child, combining academic skill-building with social-emotional growth and creative play. Kids build foundational skills in early literacy, reading, writing, language, and math - all through interactive learning games and engaging lessons. Two smiling kids using Khan Academy Kids app on tablet for interactive early learning games. Five animated Khan Academy Kids characters jump with joy. Young girl smiling behind the computer while using a free Khan Kids in a classroom setting. Created in collaboration with learning experts at Stanford, our curriculum aligns with the Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework and Common Core. Animated animal characters in a classroom setting smile with joy while reading. Inside the Khan Academy Kids app. Kids can explore thousands of playful activities, books, and videos at their own pace or follow a personalized path that grows with them. Screenshots of joyful educational games in the Khan Kids app including math and spelling games. “I began using the Khan Kids app last school year and immediately fell in love. I felt like I had finally found the app all primary teachers have been in search of - easy to use, tied to standards, differentiated, AND my kids love it!”. “Parents: If you are looking for an educational app for your 2-5 year old, download Khan Academy Kids - seriously. “My 4-year old is working on Khan Academy Kids app this morning and loving it. Proud to be a trusted name in early learning. Smiling teacher helping a young student build english language skills with Khan Academy Kids. Teacher and young student using Khan Academy Kids on tablet in classroom setting. From assigning lessons to tracking progress - see how teachers can use Khan Kids in the classroom with ease.
